mapper.insert: insert into orders.orders (id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, remark, expire_time, paid_time, cancelled_time, completed_time, created_time, updated_time) values (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{expireTime}, #{paidTime}, #{cancelledTime}, #{completedTime}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime})
